scientific_integrity: The theorem uses the previously published exact idempotent enumerator as input; novelty is confined to the rigorous fixed-block-count entropy-rate law and rank concentration. Only finite checks and an internal scientific review have been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of labeled equal-size blocks only. Logarithmic large-deviation rates, not full equivalent probabilities; finite idempotent enumeration is established prior work. Growing-block-count, prefactors, and fluctuation laws are not asserted. Possible unindexed asymptotic priority remains.
title: Block-image condensation and a sharp entropy hierarchy for partition-preserving retractions
